help.title: VIEWPOINT and LOCATIONS
help.vpBody:
The reference point (observation point) for calculating directional scores.
The map draws how each planet's energy descends across the 16 directions as seen from here.

It's used in the dropdown at the top of the search-results list, and in the VIEWPOINT switcher on the Daily chip screen.
help.locBody:
Points shown as markers on the map
(a list of places you visit often).
Once registered, the marker stays on the map,
so you can see how places relate to each other at a glance.

Tapping the "LOCATIONS" tile button at the bottom
of the Map screen lets you see, in a list,
the energy scores of your LOCATIONS (registered places)
as viewed from the VIEWPOINT.
Register the places you visit often, and you'll see
things like "this park has a high Healing score today" or
"this café has a high Love score today" —
a handy way to see how strong today's energy is
at each registered place.
help.registerBody:
Both VIEWPOINT and LOCATIONS can hold up to 5 entries each
(including your home 🏠).
Your home is placed in the first slot automatically from your profile,
so you can add up to 4 more.

Show the place you want to save at the center of the map,
then tap "Save this point" on the VIEWPOINT tab,
or "Register this point" on the LOCATIONS tab,
to save it to the current tab.
help.iconNameBody:
From the ⋯ button at the right of each slot, open the submenu
to change the name and the icon.
You can choose from 32 icons.
help.reorderBody:
Also in the ⋯ menu, use ↑ ↓ to reorder.
Slots higher up appear earlier in the list.
(Your home 🏠 is fixed at the top and can't be moved or deleted.)

popup.mapDarkBody: Switch between the normal and dark map. Choose by visibility preference.
popup.dirEnergyBody: Shows your stars' energy as 16-direction fans on the map. The darker a direction's color, the stronger its energy. Tap to filter by category.
popup.compassBody: Direction lines (N / E / S / W) seen from the center point. Helps gauge bearing.
popup.coordsBody: Shows a latitude/longitude label below the + at the center of the screen. As you move the map, the center coordinates update in real time. Tap the label to copy it to the clipboard. Useful for checking before saving a place, or for confirming the coordinates of any point. The crosshair (+) itself is always shown, even when this toggle is off.
popup.typeBody: Which chart's planets to show. Natal (fixed at birth) / Prog (one day = one year) / Transit (this very moment).
popup.groupBody:
Group filter for the 10 planets.
• Personal: $personal
• Social: $social
• Generational: $generational
popup.focusBody:
Category filter — highlights only the planets related to a theme.
• Overall: all planets
• Healing: $healing
• Abundance: $money
• Love: $love
• Work: $work
• Talk: $communication
popup.framesHead: The 4 frames of lines (Natal / Transit / Prog / S.Arc)
popup.framesBody: Draws the "main lines" of each planet × 4 angles (ASC/MC/DSC/IC) on a world scale. All 4 frames can be switched for free (Natal = fixed at birth / Transit = moving now / Prog = secondary progression / S.Arc = solar arc). The i button beside each pill has a detailed explanation.
popup.aspectBody: An extension that adds square / trine / sextile to the main lines (40 conjunction lines), for 120 lines in total. It applies to all frames that are on at the same time. Cosmic Pro only.
popup.relocateBody: Treats the point you tap on the map as a relocation destination. You can check, all together: (1) which planets' lines move closer or farther compared with your current address, (2) the sign changes of ASC / MC, and (3) the 12-house transitions of the 10 planets. Cosmic Pro only.
popup.hintBody: Because ACG lines are drawn on a world scale, at some zoom levels they may move off-screen and be hard to see. Zooming out makes the overall picture of the lines easier to see.

guide.title: How to use LOCATIONS
guide.intro:
See, at a glance, the energy of your LOCATIONS (saved places)
as viewed from the VIEWPOINT (your chosen center point) you registered.
Save the places you care about as LOCATIONS,
and you can read today's energy for each at a glance.

Register the places you visit often, and you'll see
things like "this park has a high Healing score today" or
"this café has a high Love score today" —
a handy way to see how strong today's energy is
at each saved place.
guide.dateTimeBody:
Change the "date" and "time" at the top to recalculate
the scores for that moment. The "Back to today" button
returns you to the present.
guide.viewpointBody:
The "VIEWPOINT" dropdown switches the reference point for
distance and direction scores.
You can choose the map center (current location), your current address,
or a VIEWPOINT you've saved.
guide.categoryBody:
Tap Healing / Abundance / Love / Work / Talk to switch,
and the places are re-ranked by that category's score.
Tap the same category again to deselect (= show the overall score).
guide.registerBody:
From the 📍 button on the left of the Map screen, you can save
the point at the center of the map as either a VIEWPOINT or a LOCATION.
Saved places can also be renamed or deleted.

diff.q: What's the difference between Free and Pro?
diff.a:
Stella Consultation goes from 3 / week on Free to 100 / week on Pro; Star Reading goes from "Overall" only on Free to all 5 categories on Pro; aspect lines increase from 40 on Free to 120 on Pro. Tarot is once a day on both plans, but Pro adds no credit cost when you choose a category, plus a question field.

The 4 ACG / CCG frames, search and filter for the Star Atlas and tarot history, and saving and sharing your interpretations are all available on Free too. Please see the table above for details.

weeklyCap.q: What happens if I exceed the weekly cap for Stella Consultation?
weeklyCap.a: You can keep going by purchasing additional credits. On Pro, your 100 / week are replenished at the Monday reset.

proTarot.q: What changes with Tarot on Pro?
proTarot.a:
Tarot is once a day on both Free and Pro. On Pro, you can choose the category you want to ask about (Overall · Love · Abundance · Work · Talk · Healing · Change) and draw a reading without spending any credits. You can also type what you'd like to know as a direct question, and the reading responds to it.

On Free, only Overall is free (once a day); other categories cost 1 credit each time.

outing30min.q: What does "changes 30 minutes later" mean in outing consultations?
outing30min.a:
With Cosmic Pro, you can set the time of an outing or event consultation in one-hour steps. The star lines of astrocartography (CCG) move with Earth's rotation, so even in the same place the "lead star of the moment" quietly changes within 30 minutes.

Opening "View 30 minutes later" on the result screen lets you read the shift in advance — Mars's line drawing away, or Venus's line drawing near. You begin to see how to use your time in that place, such as "the heart of it comes early" or "it warms up toward the latter half" (this is not good or bad fortune, but a shift in the quality of energy).

upgradeDowngrade.q: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
upgradeDowngrade.a: You can change it anytime from the subscription management screen in the Apple App Store or Google Play. If you cancel auto-renewal, you'll switch to the Free plan automatically from your next billing date.

afterCancel.q: What happens to features after I cancel?
afterCancel.a: You can keep using Cosmic Pro features until your current billing period ends. After it ends, you'll move to the Free plan automatically. Your history of interpretations stays saved on your device.

resubscribe.q: If I resubscribe to Pro, do my weekly credits increase?
resubscribe.a:
No. Weekly credits are managed per account and reset every Monday. Even if you cancel Pro and resubscribe right away, your remaining count at that moment doesn't change. This isn't about misuse — it simply means resubscribing can't be used as a loophole to repeatedly top up the "100 / week" allowance.

Example: if you cancel Pro on a Wednesday with 0 weekly credits left and resubscribe immediately, the remaining count stays at 0. It returns to 100 the following Monday.

declineDialog.title: Consent is required to use Solara
declineDialog.body:
To use Solara, you'll need to agree to what's described in "Before You Begin." Without your consent, the app can't be used.

Please take another look, or feel free to uninstall Solara. At this point we have not received any of your data, including any personal information, so you can uninstall with complete peace of mind.

intro.heading: ◆ Welcome
intro.body:
Solara gathers the vast data of the cosmos into one place. Behind a single moment, read through astrology, lies an enormous wealth of data. Solara hands that wealth to you as material to reflect on — a genuinely useful companion.

The text and data Solara generates are laid out as evidence, and what you read is offered as one interpretation drawn from that evidence.

Because evidence can be read in many ways, what Solara offers is only one example among many. If something in the words feels off to you, return to the evidence and add your own reading. I would be glad if you used Solara's data to explore astrology in your own way.

I built this app as a practicing astrologer. My wish is that your life shines in a way that is wholly your own.
I am praying for your happiness. I'm grateful that we met through this app. Thank you.

— From the maker of Solara

entertainment.heading: ◆ Solara is for entertainment and self-discovery
entertainment.body:
All of the following features in Solara are means for entertainment and self-discovery:

• Astrology such as birth charts, transits, and progressions
• Drawing and interpreting tarot cards
• Consultations with Stella
• Star readings
• Astrocartography on the map and directional energy scores

They are not professional medical, legal, financial, or psychological advice, and they do not predict or guarantee future events.

thirdParty.heading: ◆ Data sent to third parties
thirdParty.body:
To provide its service, Solara sends data to the following third parties:

• Apple / Google — for abuse prevention (device attestation). Attestation data is sent.
• Google Gemini AI — to generate astrology-based interpretations and tarot interpretations. Your birth details (date, time, and place of birth) and the text you enter in consultations are sent.
• RevenueCat — for purchase management. An anonymous ID and purchase information are sent.

geminiContent.heading: ◆ Content generated by Gemini AI
geminiContent.body:
Solara uses Google's Gemini AI to generate text in the following features:

• Tarot — interpretations of the cards you draw
• Stella Consultation — astrological interpretations in response to your questions
• Star Reading — interpretations across five categories (Love / Abundance / Work / Talk / Overall)
• Relocation (map) — astrological interpretations for the point you select on the map

decisions.heading: ◆ About important decisions
decisions.body:
Solara's interpretations are reference material for understanding yourself. At times they may be inaccurate, or may not fit you.

If a result feels off, please don't take it at face value. For life's important decisions — moving, changing jobs, marriage — please rely on your own judgment and on talking with family and professionals.

For details on how your data is handled, please see below.

consentHandling.heading: ◆ How your consent is handled
consentHandling.body:
When you tap "Agree and Begin," the fact that you agreed to what's described in "Before You Begin" is recorded on your device. It won't be shown again. (If the terms change, we may show this notice once more.)

If you do not agree, please tap "Decline" at the bottom of the screen and uninstall Solara. At this point, we have not received any of your data, including any personal information.
